items.scenario: Two users edit same loom assignment.
items.expected: Last-write/concurrency behavior is visible and does not create mixed context.
items.actual: The assignment/concurrency path is not atomic. upsertShiftAssignment first writes the dated shift_assignments row, then separately upserts machine_assignments and updates machines.current_order_id; updateMachineAssignment is another independent mutation. There is a unique dated-assignment key, but no advisory lock or single transaction spanning the dated row, standing worker, and standing order. A failure or race between these writes can leave mixed context, contradicting the guide's no-mixed-context expectation.

items.expected: Consent rows and sends reflect the latest valid state.

No live WhatsApp send was executed.

This is formula/source verification only; no production truth-sheet browser run was executed.

items.actual: Multi-row blended warp/weft is source-verified: calcFullTotals maps every warp row and every weft row, then reduces row costs/weights once into totals. No runtime blended recipe was executed against production in this batch.

items.expected: No rupee/paise 100× error.
items.actual: The paise-per-pick UI is source-verified to avoid a 100x error: the display multiplies the internal rupee-per-pick value by 100 for paise, and the input divides typed paise by 100 before saving to state. Wage per meter also derives from total picks times the internal rupee-per-pick value.

items.expected: Sizing cost toggles exactly once.

The UI labels in-house as already included in overhead and only shows the sizing-rate input for outsourced mode.

items.scenario: Optional winding, processing, finishing, commission, and transport.

items.actual: Optional sections are source-verified to contribute zero when disabled and their configured costs when enabled: winding, processing, finishing, commission, and transport are gated by enabledSections in calcFullTotals/calcOrderQuote. No production toggle walkthrough was executed in this batch.

items.scenario: Overhead items and manual overhead override.

items.expected: Correct for loom count, output/day, working days, and monthly output.
items.actual: Capacity and idle-capacity formulas are source-verified: ratedCapacityM = loomCount × avgOutputPerLoomPerDay × monthlyWorkingDays, utilisation = monthlyOutputM / ratedCapacityM, overhead at capacity = overheadTotalMonthly / ratedCapacityM, and idle cost is the unrecovered monthly overhead portion.

items.expected: No duplicate fixed-worker cost after repeated merge/save.
